title: Dawn Myers is making it easier to style, detangle, and care for curly hair
slides: Dawn Myers built a tool for curly hair—but will it work?
The problem: traditional brushes rip through coils and kinks
Most styling tools still assume straight hair physics
You can detangle in the shower without losing curl pattern
Test one section before trusting it on your whole head
thread_text:
1. The Brush That Breaks Curls

Dawn Myers, a Black founder, built a detangling tool specifically for textured hair. Most brushes on the market still fail at the first stroke.

2. Straight-Hair Physics

Traditional bristles are designed for hair that falls straight. On coils and kinks, they snag, rip, and destroy the curl pattern instead of separating strands.

3. Shower Detangling Without Damage

Her tool lets you detangle in the shower while preserving curl definition. No more choosing between knot-free hair and intact curls.

4. Don't Test on Your Whole Head

Even promising tools can fail on your specific texture. Myers recommends testing one small section first before committing to a full wash-day routine.

5. Would You Try It?

If a tool promised to cut detangling time without ruining your curls, would you test it on one section? Try it on a small patch this week and see.
